name: Jmd Font Manager
author: jmdm817

sections.description:
Jmd Font Manager lets you upload and manage custom fonts in WordPress.
Upload multiple files from one family, such as Regular, Medium, Bold, and Black, then select fonts separately for the website and the dashboard.

Features

  • Upload WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, and OTF fonts
  • Upload multiple weights from one font family
  • Automatically group weights into a family
  • Detect weights from filenames such as Thin, Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, and Black
  • Display a family weight range such as 100 – 900
  • Select separate general fonts for the website and dashboard
  • Select separate fonts for p and h1 through h6
  • Support for the block editor and classic editor
  • Manage and delete font families from the library
  • Restrict font management to users with the manage_options capability
  • Persian and English admin interface
  • Automatic Persian default for Persian WordPress locales, otherwise English
  • Language selector with matching RTL and LTR layouts

Usage

For best results, upload files using standard family and weight names. Example:

  • Vazirmatn-Thin.woff2
  • Vazirmatn-Light.woff2
  • Vazirmatn-Regular.woff2
  • Vazirmatn-Medium.woff2
  • Vazirmatn-Bold.woff2
  • Vazirmatn-Black.woff2

Each filename should contain the shared family name and the weight name so the weights can be detected automatically.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the jmd-font-manager folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Jmd Font Manager from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings and open Font Manager.
  4. Select font files with different weights and add them to the library.
  5. Select the general font for the website and dashboard.
  6. Optionally select separate fonts for paragraphs and h1 through h6 headings.
  7. Use the language selector to switch between Persian and English.
  8. Click Save Selections.
sections.faq:
Can I upload multiple fonts?

Yes. You can add any number of fonts and weights to the library.

Can the website and dashboard use different fonts?

Yes. The website and dashboard have separate font selections.

Are previously uploaded fonts preserved?

Yes. Existing files are preserved and grouped into families based on their filenames when possible.

Is WOFF2 supported?

Yes. WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, and OTF formats are supported.
